Ava - Growth Marketing: Kickoff for RefApp Mini (OSS starter + 3 short tutorials). We need: 1 blog launch post, micro-bench narrative, one webinar, gated landing with lead routing, and 6 social variants. Volunteers?
Ravi - DevRel: I'll own the tutorials and a 3-min demo video. Will run quick perf checks for 'local' and 'cloud' profiles.
Noah - Content: I'll write the blog and social copy. Tone: technical but concise. Two headline options: "RefApp Mini: a tiny starter for local LLM dev" or "Ship an LLM feature in minutes". Thoughts?
Ivy - Design: Can do hero + 2 screenshots + a tiny GIF. Need final headline by Wed EOD.
Tess - GrowthOps: Propose webinar Tue Jul 7 9am PT. Landing form should capture role, company size, interest. Webhook -> HubSpot with tag refapp_mini. Set auto-assign rules: >150 emp -> AE.
Ava - Growth Marketing: Benchmarks should be simple bullets: median latency and cost/1k tokens for each profile. Ravi, can you give rounded numbers and a short caveat?
Ravi - DevRel: Provisional: local median 85ms, cloud median 130ms, cloud p95 410ms. Cost: optimized profile ~2.5x cheaper. Will add "measured on our harness; results may vary".
Noah - Content: Draft tweet: "RefApp Mini: a tiny OSS starter to build and optimize LLM features. Try locally, tune for cost. Webinar Jul 7. https://redwood.ai/refapp-mini"
ops-bot: Artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/refapp-mini/v0.1/refapp-mini.tgz
Ivy - Design: Posting early mock in #design-review shortly.
Tess - GrowthOps: I'll create landing + Zapier flow and share the form link here.
Ava - Growth Marketing: Owners: Ravi (tutorial + bench), Noah (blog + socials), Ivy (assets), Tess (webinar + routing). Target publish + webinar on Jul 7 AM. Will post checklist tomorrow.
